title.en: Gender Inequality Index, Global Gender Gap Index, Gender Parity Index Comparison
title.hi: Gender Inequality Index, Global Gender Gap Index, Gender Parity Index Comparison

definition.en: These indices are critical analytical tools used to measure and compare gender-based disparities across health, education, economic participation, and political empowerment.
definition.hi: These indices are critical analytical tools used to measure and compare gender-based disparities across health, education, economic participation, and political empowerment.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these indices is essential for GS-3 as they reflect the socio-economic health of the Indian economy and the effectiveness of government policies. UPSC frequently asks questions regarding India's performance, methodology, and the policy implications of these global rankings.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding these indices is essential for GS-3 as they reflect the socio-economic health of the Indian economy and the effectiveness of government policies. UPSC frequently asks questions regarding India's performance, methodology, and the policy implications of these global rankings.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the methodology and dimensions of GII, GGGI, and GPI.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the methodology and dimensions of GII, GGGI, and GPI.

learningOutcomes.en: Evaluate India's performance and the structural challenges in achieving gender parity.
